mcq.answer_text: All combinations of a and b including empty string

sq.q: Name two types of finite automata.
answer: Deterministic Finite Automata (DFA) and Non-Deterministic Finite Automata (NFA).
Finite automata is a mathematical model of computation that consists of states and transitions, used to recognize patterns in input strings.
